paragraphs.text: 1. BORNE on with thee, O Manyu girt by Maruts, let our brave men, impetuous, bursting forward,
paragraphs.original: त्वया मन्यो सरथमारुजन्तो हर्षमाणासो धृषिता मरुत्वः ।
paragraphs.translit: tvayā manyo sarathamārujanto harṣamāṇāso dhṛṣitā marutvaḥ |

paragraphs.text: March on, like flames of fire in form, exulting, with pointed arrows, sharpening their weapons.
paragraphs.original: तिग्मेषव आयुधा संशिशाना अभि प्र यन्तु नरो अग्निरूपाः
paragraphs.translit: tigmeṣava āyudhā saṃśiśānā abhi pra yantu naro agnirūpāḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Flashing like fire, be thou, O conquering Manyu, invoked, O Victor, as our army's leader.
paragraphs.original: अग्निरिव मन्यो त्विषितः सहस्व सेनानीर्नः सहुरे हूत एधि ।
paragraphs.translit: agniriva manyo tviṣitaḥ sahasva senānīrnaḥ sahure hūta edhi |

paragraphs.text: Slay thou our foes, distribute their possessions: show forth thy vigour, scatter those who hate us.
paragraphs.original: हत्वाय शत्रून्वि भजस्व वेद ओजो मिमानो वि मृधो नुदस्व
paragraphs.translit: hatvāya śatrūnvi bhajasva veda ojo mimāno vi mṛdho nudasva

paragraphs.text: 3. O Manyu, overcome thou our assailant on! breaking, slaying, crushing down the foemen.
They have not hindered thine impetuous vigour: Mighty, Sole born! thou makest them thy subjects.
paragraphs.original: उग्रं ते पाजो नन्वा रुरुध्रे वशी वशं नयस एकज त्वम्
paragraphs.translit: ugraṃ te pājo nanvā rurudhre vaśī vaśaṃ nayasa ekaja tvam

paragraphs.text: 4. Alone or many thou art worshipped, Manyu: sharpen the spirit of each clan for battle.
paragraphs.original: एको बहूनामसि मन्यवीळितो विशंविशं युधये सं शिशाधि ।
paragraphs.translit: eko bahūnāmasi manyavīḷito viśaṃviśaṃ yudhaye saṃ śiśādhi |

paragraphs.text: With thee to aid, O thou of perfect splendour, we will uplift the glorious shout for conquest.
paragraphs.original: अकृत्तरुक्त्वया युजा वयं द्युमन्तं घोषं विजयाय कृण्महे
paragraphs.translit: akṛttaruktvayā yujā vayaṃ dyumantaṃ ghoṣaṃ vijayāya kṛṇmahe

paragraphs.text: 5. Unyielding bringing victory like Indra, O Manyu, be thou here our Sovran Ruler.
To thy dear name, O Victor, we sing praises: we know the spring from which thou art come hither.
paragraphs.original: प्रियं ते नाम सहुरे गृणीमसि विद्मा तमुत्सं यत आबभूथ
paragraphs.translit: priyaṃ te nāma sahure gṛṇīmasi vidmā tamutsaṃ yata ābabhūtha

paragraphs.text: 6. Twin-born with power, destructive bolt of thunder, the highest conquering might is thine, Subduer!
paragraphs.original: आभूत्या सहजा वज्र सायक सहो बिभर्ष्यभिभूत उत्तरम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ābhūtyā sahajā vajra sāyaka saho bibharṣyabhibhūta uttaram |

paragraphs.text: Be friendly to its in thy spirit, Manyu, O Much-invoked, in shock of mighty battle.
paragraphs.original: क्रत्वा नो मन्यो सह मेद्येधि महाधनस्य पुरुहूत संसृजि
paragraphs.translit: kratvā no manyo saha medyedhi mahādhanasya puruhūta saṃsṛji

paragraphs.text: 7. For spoil let Varuna and Manyu give us the wealth of both sides gathered and collected;
paragraphs.original: संसृष्टं धनमुभयं समाकृतमस्मभ्यं दत्तां वरुणश्च मन्युः ।
paragraphs.translit: saṃsṛṣṭaṃ dhanamubhayaṃ samākṛtamasmabhyaṃ dattāṃ varuṇaśca manyuḥ |

paragraphs.text: And let our enemies with stricken spirits, o'erwhelmed with terror, slink away defeated.
paragraphs.original: भियं दधाना हृदयेषु शत्रवः पराजितासो अप नि लयन्ताम्
paragraphs.translit: bhiyaṃ dadhānā hṛdayeṣu śatravaḥ parājitāso apa ni layantām
